examples.trans: Somewhere ages and ages hence, I shall be telling this with a sigh.

examples.text: 어디선가 준비하면 좋은 결과가 나올 거예요.
examples.trans: If we prepare (somewhere), good results will follow.

examples.text: 훗날에 나는 어디선가 한숨을 쉬면서 이야기할 것입니다.
examples.trans: Somewhere ages and ages hence, I shall be telling this with a sigh.
The topic of a sigh came up in today's meeting.

examples.text: 말을 잘 못 알아들으시네. 신디 이번 주 쉬죠?
examples.trans: You are not catching my meaning. Let's have Cindy rest this week, shall we?

examples.text: 이번 일은 꼭 잘 해결해 봐요, 쉬다는 마음으로요.
examples.trans: Let's make sure we handle this well (take a break, rest).

examples.text: 훗날에 나는 어디선가 한숨을 쉬면서 이야기할 것입니다.
examples.trans: Somewhere ages and ages hence, I shall be telling this with a sigh.

examples.text: 이번에는 꼭 제대로 해 보고 싶어요, 이야기하다는 마음으로요.
examples.trans: This time I really want to do it right (will tell).

examples.text: 숲속에 두 갈래 길이 있었다고, 나는 사람이 적게 간 길을 택했고 그것 때문에 모든 것이 달라졌다고.
examples.trans: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I took the one less traveled by—and that has made all the difference.
The topic of in the woods came up in today's meeting.

meanings.note: Usually followed by -e to mean 'because of'.

examples.trans: I was late because of the rain.
It's because of you.

meanings.note: Placed directly before a noun.

examples.trans: Everyone knows.
All preparations are finished.

examples.text: 숲속에 두 갈래 길이 있었다고, 나는 사람이 적게 간 길을 택했고 그것 때문에 모든 것이 달라졌다고.
examples.trans: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I took the one less traveled by—and that has made all the difference.

examples.text: 이번에는 꼭 제대로 해 보고 싶어요, 달라지다는 마음으로요.
examples.trans: This time I really want to do it right (that it changed).

meanings.note: Used in standard farewells 안녕히 계세요 and 안녕히 가세요.

examples.trans: Goodbye! (to someone staying)
Goodbye! (to someone leaving)

meanings.note: Honorific equivalent of 있다; used in 안녕히 계세요 ('goodbye' to someone staying).

examples.trans: Goodbye! (to someone staying)
Is the teacher inside right now?
